assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: Data were acquired using the top speed method (3 s cycle).
Peptides with charge states of 2–6 were selected from the top abundance peaks by the quadrupole for collisional dissociation (CID with normalized energy 30) MS/MS
quantification: Relative concentrations of each protein were measured via label-free quantitation in the PEAKS software by normalizing the area under the curve (AUC) for each peptide and protein to the total ion count (TIC) in each sample.
enrichment: Proteins identified from this first-level analysis of fragmentation spectra were used as a constrained database to search for ubiquitin modifications using the PTM module in PEAKS Studio.
